summary: Scorpio Tankers Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a scheduled release of its first quarter 2026 financial results and a related conference call on May 5, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings announcement with no special-situation event. No deal terms, material definitive agreement, or corporate action such as an acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation is disclosed. The filing serves only to notify shareholders of an upcoming earnings release and conference call details, which is standard operational reporting and not a special situation.
